card.name: Words that open a second alternative or hedge
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as or, of, is, may and 'least' that come right before a second option, a hedge or a qualification. It is common in label text like 'if X occurs or is suspected' and 'at least'.

modes.label: Or before a second condition
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'may' joins a second condition after a first one.
modes.example: Immediately discontinue estrogen-alone therapy if a VTE occurs<< or>> is suspected.

modes.label: Hedge or contrast setup
modes.description: A small word comes just before a hedged or contrasting phrase such as 'at least' or 'not without risk'.
modes.example: However, even short-term therapy<< is>> not without risk.

modes.label: Of before a range
modes.description: The word 'of' comes before an amount, in a comparison that sets up a contrast.
modes.example: will see decreases<< of>> 10% or more, whereas

card.writes: It pushes words that set up contrasts or paired alternatives, such as neither, only and rather, and pushes down 'at least' type words.
card.plain: It fires on little words that lead into a second option or a qualifying turn in the sentence.
